title: ModPeak Staffel 3
description: A high-performance Fabric modpack featuring Simple Voice Chat, Waystones, and advanced building tools like WorldEdit.
body:
Overview
This modpack is designed to enhance the vanilla experience with essential utility and performance mods. It focuses on multiplayer interaction and world management.

Key Features
Performance: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore for maximum FPS.

Communication: Includes Simple Voice Chat for immersive multiplayer sessions.

Exploration & Utility: Adds Waystones for fast travel and Traveler's Backpack for extra storage.

World Management: Built-in WorldEdit and LuckPerms for server administrators.

Visuals: Iris Shaders support and various UI improvements like AppleSkin and Jade.

Technical Details
This pack is optimized for both Client and Server environments.
